items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Lottie Tyler, who was my girl friend, Lottie Tyler and Edna Thomas and let me see, who else, we were considered the dicties

ctx.x: Madam Walker was one of my best friends. I used to go to her house every Sunday. Wasn't a Sunday I didn't -- didn't miss a Sunday. Lottie Tyler, who was my girl friend, Lottie Tyler and Edna Thomas and let me see, who else, we were considered the dicties, they called us dicties, you know. We were supposed to be the society of New York. Edna Thomas and Henry Branham, Jimmy Daniels -- no, that was before Jimmy's time. No, it wasn't. Jimmy used to go there. Jimmy Daniels, oh what is that boy's name? He's in Hawaii…
Grand house, wasn't it over there?
